results.name: missing metadata stays absent, and a #size label is not a measurement
positive numeric and exact decimal text remain explicit diameter and pounds per foot
clearing is an explicit unknown null, never zero or an invented default
zero, signed negative and partial numeric strings cannot become verified metadata
boolean, object, array and nonfinite values remain invalid and visibly repairable
malformed root records reject rather than normalizing to an eligible empty form
frozen source and authored buffers are not mutated or aliased during preparation
field projection is restricted to two declared optional metadata keys and detects numeric overflow or underflow
